Definition: audience, i.e. the royal court; also obedience, i.e. (concretely) a subject
BiblicalUsage: The word is the royal audience, the guard, the men who stand near the king. Ahimelech asks who is so faithful among all the servants as David, who goes at the king's bidding, and Benaiah is set over David's guard, the men who heard the king's word first.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the guard is the picture of faithfulness: David's men stood close and obeyed at a word, and the servant who goes at the King's bidding is honourable in His house.
